name: Creative Media & Community Trust Corporation
summary: Creative Media & Community Trust Corporation (CMCTP) operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT) primarily focused on acquiring, holding, and actively managing premium Class A and innovative office properties. These assets are strategically located in dynamic and growing urban centers across the United States, with a significant portion of its portfolio situated in the Los Angeles and San Francisco Bay Area markets. CMCTP also undertakes development and enhancement projects for its properties. The company's operations are managed by affiliates of CIM Group, L.P., a vertically integrated real estate firm possessing comprehensive in-house capabilities. CIM Group's expertise spans the entire real asset lifecycle, from initial research, acquisition, and credit analysis to development, financing, leasing, and on-site property management.
